camel_example: aliyun ossutil api get-vod-playlist --bucket examplebucket --channel examplechannel --region cn-hangzhou --start-time 1636600271 --end-time 1636618271
description_en: Queries the playlist generated by stream pushing for a specified LiveChannel within a specified time range
description_zh: 查看指定LiveChannel在指定时间段内推流生成的播放列表
name: GetVodPlaylist

parameters.help_en: The name of the LiveChannel. The LiveChannel must exist
parameters.name: channel

parameters.help_en:
The end time for querying TS files. The value is a UNIX timestamp.
> EndTime must be greater than StartTime, and the time span cannot exceed one day
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询ts文件的终止时间，格式为Unix timestamp。
> EndTime必须大于 StartTime，且时间跨度不能大于1天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The start time for querying TS files. The value is a UNIX timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 指定查询ts文件的起始时间，格式为Unix timestamp
parameters.name: start_time
